title: Mamba-3D as Masked Autoencoders for Accurate and Data-Efficient Analysis of Medical Ultrasound Videos
abstract: arXiv:2503.20258v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Ultrasound videos are an important form of clinical imaging data, and deep learning-based automated analysis can improve diagnostic accuracy and clinical efficiency. However, the scarcity of labeled data and the inherent challenges of video analysis have impeded the advancement of related methods. In this work, we introduce E-ViM$^3$, a data-efficient Vision Mamba network that preserves the 3D structure of video data, enhancing long-range dependencies and inductive biases to better model space-time correlations. With our design of Enclosure Global Tokens (EGT), the model captures and aggregates global features more effectively than competing methods. To further improve data efficiency, we employ masked video modeling for self-supervised pre-training, with the proposed Spatial-Temporal Chained (STC) masking strategy designed to adapt to various video scenarios. translated_title: Mamba-3D作为掩码自编码器用于医学超声视频的精确且数据高效的分析
translated_abstract: 超声视频是临床医学影像数据的重要形式，基于深度学习的自动化分析可以提高诊断准确性和临床效率。然而，标注数据的稀缺性以及视频分析固有的挑战阻碍了相关方法的发展。在这项工作中，我们提出了E-ViM³，这是一种数据高效的Vision Mamba网络，它保留了视频数据的3D结构，增强了长程依赖和归纳偏置，以更好地建模时空相关性。通过我们设计的包围全局标记（EGT），该模型比竞争方法更有效地捕获和聚合全局特征。为了进一步提高数据效率，我们采用掩码视频建模进行自监督预训练，并提出了时空链式（STC）掩码策略，旨在适应各种视频场景。实验表明，E-ViM³达到了最先进的性能……
tldr: 提出E-ViM³——一种保留视频3D结构的Vision Mamba网络，结合包围全局标记和时空链式掩码策略进行自监督预训练，实现了医学超声视频的精确且数据高效的分析。
en_tdlr: E-ViM³, a data-efficient Vision Mamba network preserving the 3D structure of video data, combined with Enclosure Global Tokens and a Spatial-Temporal Chained masking strategy for self-supervised pre-training, enables accurate and data-efficient analysis of medical ultrasound videos.
